name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_max_players_edit_kill_focus
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::OnMaxPlayersEditKillFocus clamps the max-player edit value into the accepted WOL range and rewrites the edit text.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43f450 validates signed comparisons of m_queryMaxPlayers against 2 and 4, SetWindowTextA of literal "2" with m_queryMaxPlayers = 2 for low values, SetWindowTextA of literal "4" with m_queryMaxPlayers = 4 for high values, and _ltoa(value, local 16-byte buffer, 10) followed by SetWindowTextA for in-range values.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_max_players_edit_kill_focus_smoke patches SetWindowTextA and verifies the low clamp, high clamp, and in-range decimal formatting paths, including the m_queryMaxPlayers side effects.
